data.name: PROCEDURE ZERO
data.detailed_description:
INTAKE COMPLETE


Your transport is not on the schedule. The file contains no name and no charges. Even so, the cameras are already tracking you, and the staff behave as if everything is proceeding according to plan.

PROCEDURE ZERO is a first-person prison horror where the institution is the enemy. You carry no weapon and you never kill anyone. You survive by learning the building's rhythm — and by being somewhere else when it looks your way.

WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DO


  • Read the routine. Learn what gives you away: sightlines, noise, and the places you are not supposed to be.
  • Create an opening. Use sound, radios and thrown objects to pull attention somewhere else.
  • Count the cost. Energy limits how long you can run and stay sharp. Cigarettes are currency. Getting caught takes what you carry, never your right to try again.
  • Listen to people. Conversations, favors and influence uncover what no sign will ever tell you.
  • Check the record. Notes and traces in the world say more than the announcements. Decide for yourself who — and what — to believe.

DO NOT FIGHT THE SYSTEM. SURVIVE IT.


The prison follows its own rules. The problem is that none of them can explain your presence.

MADE BY ONE PERSON


PROCEDURE ZERO was written, built and finished by a single developer in Poland. Everything you see and hear in it passed through one pair of hands.

data.short_description: Your name is missing from the register and no charges are on file — yet the cameras are already tracking you. A first-person prison horror about reading patrols, trading for information, and getting out before the system decides who you are.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1909 or newer)
  • Processor: 4 cores / 8 threads, e.g. Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game automatically selects the Low preset on weaker cards at first launch. Measured on a Radeon RX 580 8 GB: 48 FPS.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 6 cores, e.g. Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 8 GB or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Measured on an RTX 4060 Laptop: High preset, 1080p, 60 FPS with headroom.
